project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Unique identifier (GUID) of the project the workflow belongs to.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether the workflow is set to auto-start: "on" or "off".

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: Total queued messages across the workflow's topics.

type.title: Type
type.description: Node role: source | transform | destination (None if the config lacks it).

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: Number of queued messages on the node's input topics; None for source nodes (nothing feeds them) and when Kafka is unreachable.

run_commit.title: Run Commit
run_commit.description: Commit the node is pinned to run from (empty string = newest/HEAD).

template_linked.title: Template Linked
template_linked.description: Whether the node follows a catalog adapter, and so is versioned by release rather than by commit.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Every node in the workflow, with live queue counts and run pins.
